sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)
limitations: Enrichment presence depends on the index enrichment pass running (bb index runs it); an index built with enrichment disabled would show honest absence.
Multi-site verb groups render no per-site hover annotation by design (bounded hover); per-edge enrichment always surfaces on graph edges.
Overhead budget is a pure-layer proxy (2000 cycles); the in-editor 50ms hover budget with an enriched fixture is asserted in the E5 session.
